title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Gami Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Gami delivers a playful and nostalgic confectionery-inspired blend, capturing the unmistakable taste of gummy bear sweets. A medley of mixed fruit flavours provides a juicy and vibrant base, layered with sugary notes that add a familiar, sweet, and satisfying finish. The balance of fruitiness and sweetness makes this a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy classic confectionery flavours. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Gami delivers a sweet and fruity vape with discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
